# sources

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/controller/sources"
```

Package sources re\-exports the sources\-group reconciler types as public aliases. The reconcilers themselves stay in internal/controller, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct them against.
